item.text: To book a room, first submit the date and time you would like to use it. We will then check whether the room is available and send you a message confirming that we received your request. Please note that this message only confirms receipt of your request; it does not mean the room has been approved or reserved for you. Your booking is confirmed only after you receive a separate approval confirming that the requested time is available.
